> ### Coming from 2.x? Download this one by hand, once.
> The project moved to a new GitHub home, so 2.x apps can't download updates by themselves any more (they only trust the old address). Download **StashOfExile2.exe** below and replace your old one - your settings and data are kept. From 3.0 on, updates download by themselves again.
>
> **Why update:** 3.0 follows Grinding Gear Games' third-party policy. Older versions read the screen by themselves, which the policy doesn't allow - please stop using them with the game.
